notes:
## Safer
- Restart module from the SVT menu no longer opens a second connection on cars whose gateway takes one at a time; it says how to restart the module instead.
- Pressing Code by hand while an E-Sys MAX coding job runs, or with an edit saved for another car still in E-Sys's coding folder, now asks first. Wait / No is the default.
- Exclude modules checks the car and the SVT again before it loads the filter.
## Fixed
- Code several changes says clearly when a module may be coded in part, and no longer tells you to press Code NCD after it has put the files back.
- Clearing faults says "not sure" when the request went out but no answer came back, and old reasons from an earlier clear are no longer shown.
- Token and back-to-normal-mode steps say "not sure" when E-Sys stopped part way.
